scope: Distinguish Eq45 candidate-local callable/export readiness from the repository package-level unified/default velocity binding without changing either velocity field.
truth_boundary: Eq45VelocityCandidate.at_points is a callable, serializable candidate-local [u,v,w] evaluator.
Candidate-local export readiness does not mean Eq45 is the repository package-level unified/default velocity implementation.
PDE failure does not forbid saving, loading, evaluating, or exporting a callable candidate.
Neither callable export nor package binding implies visualization correspondence, PDE validity, paper-exact identity, OpenAI hidden-field recovery, or blow-up.
